title: The Book of 2 Peter Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 2 Peter — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
verses.decoded: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, writes to those who have received the same precious faith as we have through the righteousness of God and our Savior Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
verses.decoded: May grace and peace be multiplied to you through knowing God and Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
verses.decoded: God’s divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through knowing the one who called us by his own glory and goodness.

verses.kjv: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
verses.decoded: Through these, we have been given very great and precious promises so that you may share in God’s nature and escape the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.

verses.kjv: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
verses.decoded: So, make every effort to add to your faith goodness, and to goodness knowledge.

verses.kjv: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
verses.decoded: Add to knowledge self-control, to self-control patience, to patience godliness.

verses.kjv: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
verses.decoded: Add to godliness kindness, and to kindness love.

verses.kjv: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: If you have all these qualities and they are growing in you, they will keep you from being useless or unproductive in knowing our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
verses.decoded: But anyone who does not have these things is blind and forgetful, having lost the cleansing from their past sins.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
verses.decoded: So, my brothers and sisters, work hard to confirm your calling and election. If you do this, you will never stumble.

verses.kjv: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: Then you will be given a rich welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
verses.decoded: That is why I will always remind you of these things, even though you already know them and are firmly established in the truth.

verses.kjv: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
verses.decoded: I think it is right, as long as I live in this body, to keep encouraging you by reminding you.

verses.kjv: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
verses.decoded: Because I know that soon I will leave this body, just as our Lord Jesus Christ showed me.

verses.kjv: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
verses.decoded: And I will do my best to make sure that after I am gone, you will always remember these things.

verses.kjv: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.decoded: We did not follow cleverly made-up stories when we told you about the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. We were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

verses.kjv: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.decoded: He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to him from the majestic glory, saying, 'This is my beloved Son, and I am pleased with him.'

verses.kjv: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
verses.decoded: We heard this voice from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

verses.kjv: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
verses.decoded: We also have a more certain message from the prophets, and you do well to pay attention to it, as to a light shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

verses.kjv: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
verses.decoded: First, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture comes from someone’s own interpretation.

verses.kjv: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: For prophecy never had its origin in human will, but prophets spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
verses.decoded: But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive false teachings, even denying the Lord who saved them, and they will bring quick destruction on themselves.

verses.kjv: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
verses.decoded: Many will follow their harmful ways, and because of them, the truth will be spoken against.

verses.kjv: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
verses.decoded: They will use false words to make money from you because of greed. Their punishment has been delayed for a long time, but it will not be avoided, and their destruction will not be asleep.

verses.kjv: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
verses.decoded: God did not spare the angels who sinned, but sent them to hell, putting them in chains of darkness to be kept for judgment.

verses.kjv: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.decoded: He did not spare the ancient world but saved Noah, the eighth person, who preached righteousness, when he brought the flood on the ungodly world.

verses.kjv: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
verses.decoded: He turned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes and condemned them by destroying them, making them an example for those who would live ungodly lives later.

verses.kjv: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
verses.decoded: He rescued just Lot, who was troubled by the immoral behavior of the wicked people around him.

verses.kjv: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
verses.decoded: That righteous man, living among them, was deeply distressed every day by their evil actions that he saw and heard.

verses.kjv: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
verses.decoded: The Lord knows how to rescue godly people from trials and keep the unjust for punishment on the day of judgment.

verses.kjv: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
verses.decoded: But especially those who follow their sinful desires and reject authority. They are arrogant and stubborn, not afraid to insult important people.

verses.kjv: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
verses.decoded: Even angels, who are more powerful and mighty, do not bring insulting accusations against them before the Lord.

verses.kjv: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
verses.decoded: But these people are like wild animals, born to be caught and destroyed. They speak evil about things they do not understand and will be destroyed by their own corruption.

verses.kjv: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
verses.decoded: They will be punished for their evil deeds, as those who enjoy sinning in broad daylight. They are like spots and blemishes, fooling themselves while they enjoy their feasts with you.

verses.kjv: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
verses.decoded: They have eyes full of adultery and cannot stop sinning. They deceive unstable souls. Their hearts are trained in greed. They are cursed children.

verses.kjv: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
verses.decoded: They have left the right path and gone astray, following the way of Balaam son of Bosor, who loved the reward of wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
verses.decoded: But Balaam was rebuked for his sin when a dumb donkey spoke with a human voice and stopped the prophet's madness.

verses.kjv: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
verses.decoded: These people are like wells without water and clouds blown by a storm. Darkness is kept forever for them.

verses.kjv: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
verses.decoded: When they say proud and empty words, they lure people who have just escaped from those living in error by appealing to their sinful desires.

verses.kjv: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
verses.decoded: They promise freedom, but they themselves are slaves of corruption. A person is controlled by whatever overcomes them.

verses.kjv: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
verses.decoded: If they have escaped the pollution of the world by knowing the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ but become involved in it again and are defeated, their last condition is worse than the first.

verses.kjv: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
verses.decoded: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than to know it and then turn away from the holy command given to them.

verses.kjv: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
verses.decoded: It is true what the proverb says: 'A dog returns to its vomit,' and 'A washed pig returns to wallow in the mud.'

verses.kjv: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
verses.decoded: I am now writing this second letter to you, dear friends, to remind you and encourage your pure minds.

verses.kjv: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
verses.decoded: So you remember the words spoken earlier by the holy prophets and the command given by us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior.

verses.kjv: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
verses.decoded: First, know this: in the last days, scoffers will come, following their own desires.

verses.kjv: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
verses.decoded: They will say, 'Where is the promise of his coming? Since our ancestors died, everything has continued as it has from the beginning of creation.'

verses.kjv: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
verses.decoded: They deliberately ignore this fact: by God's word, long ago the heavens existed, and the earth was formed from water and surrounded by water.

verses.kjv: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
verses.decoded: At that time, the world was destroyed by being flooded with water.

verses.kjv: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
verses.decoded: But now, by the same word, the heavens and earth are being kept for fire, reserved for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly people.

verses.kjv: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.decoded: Dear friends, don’t forget this one thing: with the Lord, one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like one day.

verses.kjv: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.decoded: The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some think of slowness, but he is patient with you, not wanting anyone to be lost but everyone to turn to him.

verses.kjv: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verses.decoded: But the day of the Lord will come unexpectedly, like a thief at night. Then the heavens will disappear with a loud noise, the elements will melt in the heat, and the earth and everything in it will be burned up.

verses.kjv: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
verses.decoded: Since all these things will be destroyed, what kind of people should you be? You should live holy and godly lives.

verses.kjv: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
verses.decoded: You should be looking forward to and hurrying the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
verses.decoded: But we are waiting, as he promised, for new heavens and a new earth where righteousness lives.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
verses.decoded: So, dear friends, since you are waiting for these things, work hard to be found by him at peace, without fault and blameless.

verses.kjv: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
verses.decoded: Remember that the Lord’s patience means salvation, just as our dear brother Paul wrote to you with the wisdom God gave him.

verses.kjv: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
verses.decoded: In all his letters, he talks about these things. Some parts are hard to understand, and those who are ignorant and unstable twist them, just like they do with other scriptures, leading to their own destruction.

verses.kjv: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
verses.decoded: So, dear friends, since you already know these things, be careful not to be led away by the wrong ideas of evil people and lose your firm position.

verses.kjv: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: Instead, grow in God’s grace and in your knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. All glory belongs to him now and forever. Amen.
